hypotheses.claim: The public merged Qwen/mmproj media embeddings are sufficient for Frank's first-stage user-specific MVC familiarity/open-set discriminator after deterministic pooling and calibration, eliminating a second heavy visual encoder.
support: Transformers Qwen3.5 exposes image features before language decoding.
llama.cpp libmtmd exposes output media embeddings after encode.
The existing QNDRF candidate already requires same-encode reuse before a duplicate backbone.
hypotheses.cheapest_falsifier: Matched known/near-neighbor-unknown/OOD screenshot benchmark comparing merged-feature MVC against a dedicated lightweight embedding baseline at equal calibration protocol.
hypotheses.promotion_rule: Promote only if open-set/selective-risk performance is non-inferior under a pre-registered task-risk margin and total latency/RAM/VRAM/decoder-call cost is Pareto-competitive or better.

hypotheses.claim: If raw merged Qwen features are not sufficiently calibrated, a tiny learned projection over frozen merged features can recover user-specific instance/layout separation without another deep visual encode.
hypotheses.cheapest_falsifier: Train a small projection only on frozen GOLD/SILVER admitted examples and compare held-out/OOD open-set metrics against raw merged features and the dedicated encoder baseline.
hypotheses.guard: No online update is promoted without candidate shadow evaluation, atomic versioning and last-known-good rollback.

hypotheses.claim: A two-view descriptor from the same Qwen vision encode can combine pre-merger spatial patch geometry with merged LLM-token geometry and may outperform merged-only familiarity without a second heavy encoder.
support: Current Transformers Qwen3.5 VisionModel returns both pre-merger last_hidden_state and merged pooler_output from one vision forward pass.
hypotheses.runtime_constraint: Current public libmtmd API exposes merged output embeddings but not the pre-merger hidden-state view.
hypotheses.cheapest_falsifier: Do not extend/fork libmtmd unless merged-only or tiny-projection variants fail the pre-registered open-set criterion. Then instrument pre-merger features in a bounded experimental branch and measure incremental gain versus maintenance/runtime cost.

hypotheses.claim: MVC prototype validity depends on the complete visual runtime/preprocessing compatibility envelope, not only model/mmproj weights.
support: Current llama.cpp issue evidence reports Qwen3.5 visual crashes or incorrect vision behavior depending on batch, Flash Attention, KV layout and multimodal processing path.
Visual preprocessing/orientation/token-grid changes can alter the representation consumed downstream.
hypotheses.cheapest_falsifier: Matched fixture feature-drift matrix across runtime SHA, backend, preprocessing path, image-token budget and canonicalization version; demonstrate stable geometry and behavior despite those changes.

hypotheses.claim: Cheap unchanged-frame suppression should hash canonicalized perceived pixels/ROI plus source epoch rather than raw file bytes, so EXIF/container differences cannot silently poison familiarity identity.
hypotheses.cheapest_falsifier: Orientation/metadata metamorphic tests where visually equivalent inputs must map to the same canonical pixel identity while perceptually different orientations must not collide.
